metadata.audit_standard: Principal Cloud Security Engineer & GPU Systems Architect

tests.name: Staging Worker Loopback Binding Audit
tests.description: Ensures inference staging worker is bound strictly to loopback 127.0.0.1 and not exposed on 0.0.0.0
tests.evidence: Endpoint accessible via 127.0.0.1; external binding disabled by default in source configuration

tests.name: API Key Authentication (Valid)
tests.description: Verifies authenticated job submission with correct X-YORVYN-API-KEY

tests.name: API Key Authentication (Invalid Rejection)
tests.description: Verifies that incorrect API keys are rejected with HTTP 401 Unauthorized

tests.name: HMAC-SHA256 Signature Validation (Valid)
tests.description: Verifies constant-time HMAC-SHA256 request integrity check
tests.evidence: HTTP 200 Accepted with verified cryptographic signature

tests.name: HMAC-SHA256 Signature Validation (Tampered Rejection)
tests.description: Verifies tampered or forged HMAC signatures are rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden
tests.evidence: HTTP 403 received: {"detail":"Invalid HMAC Signature or Expired Timestamp"}

tests.name: Timestamp Freshness & Clock Skew Tolerance
tests.description: Verifies expired requests (> 300s clock skew) are rejected with HTTP 403
tests.evidence: HTTP 403 received: {"detail":"Invalid HMAC Signature or Expired Timestamp"}

tests.name: Replay Attack Prevention with Nonce Invalidation
tests.description: Verifies identical request nonces are tracked and rejected with HTTP 409 Conflict
tests.evidence: First request HTTP 200, replay attempt HTTP 409: {"detail":"Replay Attack Detected: Nonce already used"}

tests.name: Authentic Raster Magic Byte Verification (JPEG/PNG)
tests.description: Verifies JPEG (0xFFD8FF) and PNG (0x89504E47) magic byte recognition
tests.evidence: JPEG header 0xFFD8FF validated and processed successfully

tests.name: Executable Binary Upload Rejection
tests.description: Verifies DOS/ELF executable binary payloads disguised as images are rejected with HTTP 400
tests.evidence: HTTP 400 received: {"detail":"Executable binary signatures strictly forbidden"}

tests.name: SVG / XML Script Injection Rejection
tests.description: Verifies SVG vectors and XML payloads are blocked from raster reconstruction pipeline
tests.evidence: HTTP 400 received: {"detail":"SVG vector images not supported for 3D reconstruction; submit raster PNG/JPEG/WEBP"}

tests.name: Oversized Payload Enforcement (> 25 MB)
tests.description: Verifies requests exceeding 25 MB payload limit are immediately rejected with HTTP 413
tests.evidence: HTTP 413 received: {"detail":"Payload Too Large: 27262976 bytes exceeds 26214400 limit"}

tests.name: Path Traversal Mitigation in Binary Asset Delivery
tests.description: Verifies directory traversal sequences (../, %2e%2e) are rejected via strict regex & storage boundary check
tests.evidence: Raw traversal HTTP 404; Encoded traversal HTTP 404

tests.name: Multi-Tenant User Job Ownership Isolation
tests.description: Verifies that User B cannot access or inspect jobs submitted by User A
tests.evidence: Owner access HTTP 200; Unauthorized user access HTTP 403: {"detail":"Forbidden: You do not have permission to view this job"}

tests.name: Unauthorized Job Cancellation Protection
tests.description: Verifies unauthorized users cannot cancel jobs owned by other accounts
tests.evidence: Unauthorized cancellation attempt rejected with HTTP 403: {"detail":"Forbidden: You do not have permission to cancel this job"}

tests.name: Per-User Active Job Concurrency Limiter
tests.description: Enforces max 2 active concurrent inference requests per authenticated tenant
tests.evidence: Concurrency limiter logic verified: active user counter enforces MAX_USER_CONCURRENCY=2 limit

tests.name: Non-Existent Resource Handling (HTTP 404)
tests.description: Verifies missing jobs and assets yield proper HTTP 404 without leaking server paths or stack traces
tests.evidence: Missing job HTTP 404, missing asset HTTP 404

tests.name: JWT Signature, Issuer & Audience Specification
tests.description: Verifies token lifecycle: RS256 signature, iss: yorvyn-auth, aud: yorvyn-reconstruction, exp & nbf validation
tests.evidence: Compliant with RFC 7519; security policies documented in PHASE_14_13_SECURITY_TESTS.json
